headline: Seattle Pacific beat Western Oregon again
dek: Western Oregon still top the table, but both of their defeats by a member this season have come at Seattle Pacific, the latest on Saturday. They have lost four matches all season, the rest to sides outside the conference.

pattern.label: derived
pattern.text: Saint Martin's 32 goals are more than Simon Fraser, Western Washington or Northwest Nazarene have scored, yet they sit bottom of the table: most of their goals have come against sides outside the conference, not in the matches the table counts.

wire.line: Seattle Pacific have won seventeen matches, more than any other programme, yet sit behind Western Oregon in the table.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Three matches whose dates have passed carry no result, and every one of them is a Simon Fraser home match from August.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Archie Dhima has sixteen goals from 57 shots for Western Oregon.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Juan Diaz has nine assists for Saint Martin's.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Elijah Brockl has kept seven shutouts for Northwest Nazarene.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Of the shots on target Austin Valdez has faced for Western Oregon, 89 were saved and 25 went in.

last_match.line: Seattle Pacific have won every match since losing at Western Oregon in October.

next_match.line: Fort Lewis have already lost at Northwest Nazarene this season.

validation.policy: observed and derived claims are recomputed against the data home before publish; failures are dropped, not softened. signal and projected pass on schema unless the data contradicts a figure. context is never validated as a finding.
